2f4852c.summary: Handles another player joining the battle room, reacting by connection status: restarts a reconnect, starts the match, or sends a wrong-room message.

2f48964.summary: Logs a failed server connection and reports an error for connection statuses it does not handle.

2f48aa4.summary: Handles failure to join a room: leaves practice rooms, or cancels the search/reconnect when a reconnect room no longer exists.

2f48c44.summary: Reacts to a network disconnect depending on connection status: leaves battle, attempts reconnection, or cancels searching.

2f48ea8.summary: After a random matchmaking join fails, goes offline for bot modes or either joins another event room or creates one after enough attempts.

2f492e8.summary: Returns whether enough matchmaking attempts have failed that the client should create a room instead of joining one.

2f49334.summary: Handles a player disconnect event, marking the opponent disconnected or cancelling a practice match depending on connection status.

2f48268.summary: Marks the opponent as disconnected, notifies the battle manager, and sets status to waiting for opponent reconnection.

2f49a0c.summary: Coroutine step that shows queued battle tips with background colour and alpha, waits the tip duration, then removes the tip or hides the panel.

2f49534.summary: Returns the global variables object from the player data manager, if available.

2f49644.summary: Shows a 'can't do that' voice line and queues a tip message, starting the tip display coroutine if the tip panel is hidden.

2f496a4.summary: Queues a heads-up tip message (unless it is spam) and starts the tip display coroutine if the panel is hidden.

2f497f0.summary: Returns true if the new tip text equals the most recently queued tip, via reference and string comparison.

2f49880.summary: Returns whether the tip queue has reached the configured maximum size and holds more than one tip.

2f49984.summary: Returns whether the tip queue contains any tips.

2f498f8.summary: Creates the DisplayTip coroutine enumerator with the given background options.

2f49d2c.summary: Checks whether a board criteria is met (turn owner, random chance, or count of matching targets compared to a reference value).

2f4a13c.summary: Checks whether a card library satisfies a warlord's deck criteria by counting cards that match and comparing to the required count.

2f4a3a4.summary: Returns the remaining mana (an obscured int) of the player or enemy manager.

2f4a3bc.summary: Returns the total mana (an obscured int) of the player or enemy manager.

2f4a508.summary: Sets the trait icon sprite and material on all icon renderers, toggles the inactive icons, and updates the counter text.

2f4a688.summary: Sets the counter text to the given number and shows the counter only when it is positive.

2f4a6e8.summary: Toggles between the with-counter and without-counter game objects.

2f4a744.summary: Creates and sets up a DOTween float tween that fades the icon to a target alpha over a time.

2f4a850.summary: Plays a yoyo scale pulse animation on the icon, killing any previous highlight animation first.

2f4a958.summary: Tween setter that sets the nested fade group's alpha and recalculates its total alpha from its parent.

2f4d43c.summary: On pointer enter, forwards to the scroll rect, notifies the card, and starts a drag begin event if the mouse is held.

2f4d6c8.summary: On pointer exit, ends any drag, stops card description display, clears combat preview highlights and restores the card highlight state and colours.

2f4d928.summary: Handles dragging a card: starts an attack for cards in play, or begins moving a hand card into play when dragged far enough.

2f4da8c.summary: On end drag, forwards the end-drag event to the scroll rect's handlers.

2f4dba8.summary: On begin drag, forwards to the scroll rect and records the current frame count.

2f4dd04.summary: On pointer down, forwards to scroll rect, records touch position/time, and shows deck size or selects the card depending on its state.

2f4de78.summary: On pointer up, forwards the pointer-up event to the scroll rect's handlers.

2f4df94.summary: On pointer click, handles clicking a card: uses waystone, shows the card in hand or displays the large card view with effects.

2f4e100.summary: Returns the collider's original size, initializing it first if it is still zero.

2f4e1d4.summary: Setter for the original box collider size.

2f4e1e4.summary: Setter for the original box collider offset.

2f4e180.summary: Stores the box collider's original size and offset, disables the big collider, and sets the in-hand size and offset.

2f4e24c.summary: Restores the collider's normal size and offset when the card is not in hand, unless it is in the cemetery or removed.

2f4e314.summary: Sets the box collider size and offset for a card in hand using the height multiplier.
